title: An LLM-assisted theoretical model for aeroengine installation noise scattering
abstract: arXiv:2611.18796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A theoretical model is developed for the canonical problem of aeroengine fan noise impinging on, and scattering from, a nearby semi-infinite rigid plate. The model chains two Wiener--Hopf problems in different coordinate systems. The first stage solves the duct-radiation problem analytically in axisymmetric cylindrical coordinates. The second stage expands the field incident on the plate into a double angular spectrum of plane waves: the axial spectrum is inherited from the first stage, while the spanwise spectrum is generated by a Weyl--Sommerfeld expansion of the cylindrical harmonics. Each spectral component is then scattered by the plate. The mathematical crux is the coordinate transformation between the axisymmetric duct frame and the Cartesian plate frame. translated_title: 一种大语言模型辅助的航空发动机安装噪声散射理论模型
translated_abstract: 针对航空发动机风扇噪声入射到附近半无限大刚性平板并被散射这一典型问题，本文建立了一个理论模型。该模型在不同坐标系中将两个维纳-霍夫问题串联起来：第一阶段在轴对称柱坐标系中解析求解管道辐射问题；第二阶段将入射到平板上的声场展开为平面波的双角谱，其中轴向谱继承自第一阶段，展向谱则由柱谐函数的Weyl-Sommerfeld展开生成。随后，各谱分量分别被平板散射。数学上的关键难点在于轴对称管道坐标系与笛卡尔平板坐标系之间的坐标变换。核心物理洞见——即Weyl-Sommerfeld恒等式可在这两个坐标系之间提供精确的谱桥接——完全源自作者本人。
tldr: 本文提出一种大语言模型辅助的理论模型，通过串联两个不同坐标系下的维纳-霍夫问题，并利用Weyl-Sommerfeld恒等式作为两坐标系间的精确谱桥接，解析求解了航空发动机风扇噪声被附近半无限大刚性平板散射的问题。
